title: Billing Desk Guidance: Charging Optional Items and Services (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
Optional items and services of Ancillary and Optional Services Billing, whatever the payer, are supplied only when the resident or representative asks for them, at the price disclosed beforehand from the center's price schedule. An optional item is charged only against the resident's or representative's request for it.

## The request behind the charge

The charge rests on the company's record of the resident's or representative's request, read before the charge is posted: the request itself, what was asked for, and the item or service it concerns. The charge names the request it is made against. A charge for an optional item with no such request on record does not meet this condition.

## Pricing

- **A charge** is the quantity times the unit price, rounded half up to the cent.
- **A non-medical van trip** is the base charge plus the loaded miles times the per-mile charge, plus escort time in quarter hours at the escort hourly charge.
- **A guest meal on Thanksgiving, Christmas or Easter** is charged at the holiday guest meal price.

The unit prices are those of the center's price schedule for the item, disclosed before the item is supplied.

## Worked charges (hypothetical quantities, schedule prices)

| Hypothetical item | Calculation in words | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Van trip: base charge | 1 trip times USD 45.00 | USD 45.00 |
| Van trip: 13.4 loaded miles | 13.4 times USD 2.15 per loaded mile | USD 28.81 |
| Van trip: escort for 1 hour 15 minutes, that is 5 quarter hours | 5 quarter hours, each a quarter of USD 32.00 per hour | USD 40.00 |
| Whole van trip | USD 45.00 plus USD 28.81 plus USD 40.00 | USD 113.81 |
| 3 guest lunches on Easter | 3 times the holiday guest meal price of USD 16.00 | USD 48.00 |
| A second van trip with 9.7 loaded miles | 9.7 times USD 2.15 is USD 20.855, rounded half up | USD 20.86 for the miles |

## Points of judgement

- **Does the payer change the request condition?** No. The request condition applies whatever the payer.
- **A guest dinner is served on Christmas Day.** It is charged at the holiday guest meal price rather than the dinner price.
- **Is an optional item supplied before its price is disclosed?** No; it is supplied at the price disclosed beforehand.
